objectives.target_rating: GM-strength aspiration; not a measured rating
primary: reduce tactical blunders and centipawn loss
prefer coordinated, active and structurally sound positions
use high-quality master opening statistics with a deterministic fallback
improve endgame precision with tablebase probes

evaluation.mode: NNUE when trained weights exist; otherwise HCE V7
hce_terms: doubled, isolated, backward and passed pawns
rook open/semi-open files and seventh-rank activity
endgame king activity and rook coordination
evaluation.structural_rules: Soft evaluation penalties only; do not forbid a move when concrete tactics justify a structural concession.

capture_penalty.application: Move-scoring penalty in root search, negamax and quiescence
capture_penalty.piece_penalty: half the capturing piece's own material value
capture_penalty.opening_and_tablebase: Capturing shortcut moves are not played directly; they fall back to V7 search.

search.node_count: measured for diagnostics only; not a stopping condition
optimizations: Parse FEN placement directly for transposition-table hashing instead of allocating a temporary board matrix
Pass previous-move context through recursive search rather than rebuilding the full move history at every node

training.positions: sampled from human master PGNs and labelled by Stockfish

required: paired V7-vs-V6 matches with colours swapped
validation.rating_claim_policy: Do not claim GM or 3500 Elo strength without statistically meaningful testing.
